task_metadata.research_topic: pocket-conditioned 3D molecule generation for structure-based drug design
task_metadata.research_question: Design a generative model for pocket-conditioned 3D molecule generation across de novo, linker, and fragment-growing scenarios on CrossDocked2020.
notes: Task scope and baselines were taken from config.json and task_description.md.
Coverage includes de novo, linker, and fragment-growing SBDD papers plus the CrossDocked2020 benchmark dataset.

tests.label: denovo
tests.notes: De novo pocket-conditioned generation on the CrossDocked2020 benchmark.

tests.label: linker
tests.notes: Linker generation over the same CrossDocked2020 substrate.

baselines.name: targetdiff
baselines.notes: Matches the TargetDiff baseline named in the task description.

baselines.name: diffbp
baselines.notes: Matches the DiffBP baseline named in the task description.

baselines.name: pocket2mol
baselines.notes: Matches the Pocket2Mol baseline named in the task description.
